items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: She said, 'Pop, I'm in the band'

ctx.x: this?' [LAUGHS] I said, 'Sure I can play it. Give it to me.' So I played it for her. She said, 'Show me how to play it.' So I showed her the embrochure, which Chuck Peterson had taught me in the Army, a good embrochure, the right kind, and I showed her the chromatic scale. And up she goes, back up to the attic, and she started. And every time I'd drive into the driveway, I'd hear this trumpet. And the first thing I know, she comes home, she's saying, 'Pop, I'm in the band' -- fifth trumpet or something like that.
